scope: Current GameView layout metrics. Capture and visually inspect this exact screen separately; this test does not claim an image was reviewed.

checks.name: Scroll viewport stays inside the current screen safe area
All purchase targets meet the shared 96-unit minimum
Active dynamic text fits its own TMP bounds
Reward rows stay in their own group and clear purchase/status text
First product is reachable at top of scroll
Final product is reachable at bottom of scroll
Every card remains inside the content width
